ideas.pitch: An agentic multimodal tool for astrophysicists that ingests raw space telescope fits images and logs to automatically detect anomalies and generate natural-language research briefings.
ideas.problem_statement: Tool that accelerates research or solves operational bottlenecks in Space research.
ideas.title: AstroVision Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Space track which has fewer submissions, and delivers a working agentic workflow inspired by multi-agent audit architectures that judges love.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal BioTech copilot that allows researchers to photograph microscope slides or gel electrophoresis results and queries an LLM grounded in localized lab protocol PDFs.
ideas.problem_statement: Tool that accelerates research in BioTech.
ideas.title: BioLens Lab Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the BioTech domain with a live, demonstrable multimodal computer vision component that works instantly on standard laptop cameras.

ideas.pitch: An interactive education platform where students upload handwritten math problem photos or textbook pages, and an AI tutor guides them using voice synthesis and step-by-step visual hints.
ideas.problem_statement: Application that improves access to learning in Education.
ideas.title: EduScribe Multimodal Tutor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines speech-to-speech interaction with image analysis, mimicking award-winning conversational agents with high emotional and pedagogical resonance.

ideas.pitch: An operational bottleneck analyzer for satellite telemetry data and ground station schedules, using an agentic system to flag scheduling conflicts and propose resolution actions.
ideas.problem_statement: System that solves an overlooked operational bottleneck in Space research.
ideas.title: OrbitLogistics Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the operational bottleneck angle in Space, which appeals directly to organizer criteria regarding real-world problem-solving and agentic workflows.

ideas.pitch: An interactive multimodal assistant for biology students that turns dense academic research papers into conversational audio dialogues with instant visual pathway diagrams.
ideas.problem_statement: Application that improves access to learning and accelerates research in BioTech.
ideas.title: BioSynthesize Docent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges Education and BioTech tracks with a polished, fully functioning live demo that translates complex data into accessible formats.
